title: Blazing Team: Masters of Yo Kwon Do
description: As a mysterious ‘darkness’ rises, a group of heroic teens is assembled to harness the awesome mystical power of YO KWON DO, a practice that defeats evil by blending the skill of yo-yo with the martial art of Kung Fu.

episodes.title: S1-E13A Rock and a Shard Place

episodes_data.title: Blazing Team: Masters of Yo Kwon Do 1x1
episodes_data.description: When darkness falls over Union City, a group of teenagers are chosen to fight against chaos brought on by the world's imbalance by using yo kwon do, an ancient fighting style that combines martial arts with yo-yo trickery.

episodes_data.title: Blazing Team: Masters of Yo Kwon Do 1x2
episodes_data.description: One of Scott's friends is infected with dark energy when he touches a mysterious rock, giving the Blazing Team their first big challenge.

episodes_data.title: Blazing Team: Masters of Yo Kwon Do 1x3
episodes_data.description: A terrible magician with delusions of grandeur gets infected by a Dark Shard allowing him to pull Dark Energy out of his hat.

episodes_data.title: Blazing Team: Masters of Yo Kwon Do 1x4
episodes_data.description: A sleazy real estate mogul sets his sights on owning the Blazing Team HQ high rise by using a newly created double-black yo-yo as a means to this end.

episodes_data.title: Blazing Team: Masters of Yo Kwon Do 1x5
episodes_data.description: When a circus ringmaster and his star elephant are infected with Dark Energy, Wilson and Parker must learn to value each other's contributions and work together in order to stop their rampage through Union City.

episodes_data.title: Blazing Team: Masters of Yo Kwon Do 1x6
episodes_data.description: An aspiring cook has his recipe stolen by an established chef; Maddie learns that there's such a thing as too much truth.

episodes_data.title: Blazing Team: Masters of Yo Kwon Do 1x7
episodes_data.description: A TV weather girl becomes infected with a shard which gives her the power to control the weather; Scott enjoys the Team's newfound fame and notoriety, leading him to slack off his Yo Kwon Do practice and put his teammates in danger.

episodes_data.title: Blazing Team: Masters of Yo Kwon Do 1x8
episodes_data.description: When seismologist Dan Andreas is infected with Dark Energy, he develops the ability to cause earthquakes when he punches the ground; Parker gets a power-up.

episodes_data.title: Blazing Team: Masters of Yo Kwon Do 1x9
episodes_data.description: The team faces off against a shard-infected nosy neighbor with a thousand eyes as Wilson struggles with his obsession over gadgets, technology, and the internet.

episodes_data.title: Blazing Team: Masters of Yo Kwon Do 1x10
episodes_data.description: We meet Otto Krumholz, the Team's biggest fan. When he's shunned and mocked by Wilson, a one-time friend, Otto finds himself imbalanced and infected by a dark shard, whose power he uses to wreak technological havoc.
